Overview

Zagreb is a city in City of Zagreb with a population of 806,341. Croatia’s vibrant capital, a city of Austro-Hungarian elegance, colorful street art, a thriving café culture, and the historic Upper Town with its medieval charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
